interpretation: Saves only 3s vs default loader on warm-NVMe path (statistically zero).
Reason: NVMe-to-HBM is already PCIe-bandwidth bound. Concurrent reads don't help when single reader saturates the link.
RunAI Streamer's value is conditional: wins on S3-backed sources (latency parallelism), neutral on local NVMe.
Steering implication: only enable runai_streamer when load source is S3 or other high-latency storage.
